C. BRIEF DESCRIPTIONS

This earthquake was felt in many provinces in China. Only the observations in
Guangdong Province are covered in the following descriptions.

Guangdong Province

Guangzhou 14:05 - Many frightened and ran outdoors
- Cracks in many houses
- Many masonry houses collapsed
- Waves on ponds
